text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............Phew.
It's gotten quite late, hasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(My schedule has fallen further behind than
anticipated...
even though this assignment is due
tomorrow.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(A complete miscalculation. I should have
scheduled this with far more leeway.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being earnest and demanding of herself,
Rose Kingdom deeply faulted her own lapses
in schedule management and sank into
dejection.
